test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average of 10 consecutive even numbers is 25. If the even number just preceding the smallest of the 10 given numbers is also included, then what will be the new average?
solution: Given: An average of 10 consecutive even numbers = 25 Formula used: Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of observations Sum of A.P. = (n/2) × [2a + (n – 1)d] Where n is the total terms, a is the first term, and d is the common difference Calculation: The sum of all 10 consecutive odd numbers = 10 × 25
